name: vLLM Ascend CPU (Lint & UT Dev Container)
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y ccache dos2unix gcc g++ cmake make && ccache --set-config=max_size=10G && find /workspace/vllm-ascend -name '*.sh' -exec dos2unix {} \; && pip3 install --root-user-action=ignore --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu --extra-index-url https://repo.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi -r requirements-dev.txt && pip3 install --root-user-action=ignore torch==2.10.0 torchvision setuptools-scm pybind11 cmake --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip3 install --root-user-action=ignore vllm --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu && pip3 install --root-user-action=ignore --no-build-isolation -e . && pip3 install --root-user-action=ignore coverage && echo 'import sys;from unittest.mock import Mock;sys.modules["vllm.cumem_allocator"]=Mock();sys.modules["vllm.device_allocator.cumem"]=Mock()' > /tmp/mock_cumem.py && sed -i '1i import sys;from unittest.mock import Mock;sys.modules["vllm.cumem_allocator"]=Mock();sys.modules["vllm.device_allocator.cumem"]=Mock()' tests/ut/conftest.py
